critique: The note proves an exact projection theorem, closed sharp endpoints, and endpoint-attaining full latent laws for the finite-ordered survivor-complier estimand, rather than merely an outer bound. Its inference contribution is limited to a fixed-law directional limit and a conservative deterministic guard; calibrated first-order uniform multiplier inference under changing survivor support remains explicitly open. The result is confined to finite outcomes and covariates under cellwise weak selection monotonicity, so it does not establish a broadly reusable characterization beyond this specialized partial-transport problem. The framing accurately distinguishes the proved guard from the open multiplier frontier and contains no material stale claim of matched or calibrated inference.
